about: Uxbridge Township is a rural municipality in Durham Region, Ontario, on the Oak Ridges Moraine northeast of Toronto. The village of Uxbridge anchors farms, estate lots, and trail country rather than a continuous urban core. It is known for cycling routes and conservation lands. About 22,000 people live in Uxbridge Township.
